description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter application, including UI components such as dashboard layout, charts, course lists, and various UI helper widgets. It interacts with state providers for authentication and course data.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the home screen/dashboard of the app.

classes.name: _HeroIntroCard
classes.description: A widget displaying an introductory hero card with gradient background and a start button.

classes.name: _QuickActionsGrid
classes.description: Displays a grid of quick action tiles for notes, assignments, practice, resources.

classes.name: _KpiRow
classes.description: Displays a row of KPI cards with statistics.

classes.name: _ChartPlaceholder
classes.description: Displays a placeholder chart with animated bars.

classes.name: _MockBadge
classes.description: Displays a badge indicating whether mock mode or live mode is active.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeScreen widget.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Initializes providers when dependencies change, only once.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the home screen including all UI components.
